seo.title: Partial Video Recording for Web Apps | Sicorder
seo.description: Sicorder is a Chrome extension for partial video recording. Record one webpage area for product demos, tutorials, or marketing, with optional audio.

hero.title: Partial video recording for focused app demos
hero.subtitle: Record one chart, panel, or interaction from a webpage as an MP4, or save it as a PNG. Add tab audio, microphone narration, or both.
hero.ctaSoon: Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store
hero.note: Free · Runs entirely in your browser

problem.title: Record one area of a large app—not the whole screen
problem.text: For a product demo, tutorial, or marketing video, viewers need to see the feature—not the entire dashboard. Typical screen recording captures the whole browser; then you crop, trim, and export. If the detail you need occupied a small part of the original frame, enlarging it from compressed footage can soften text and controls. Sicorder is a Chrome extension for partial screen recording: select a webpage element, and the saved MP4 is framed to that area. That removes the separate crop-and-export step. The MP4 is still encoded video, but you avoid upscaling and re-encoding a crop after recording.

howItWorks.title: Record part of a webpage in three steps

pick.title: Pick a region
pick.text: Click the sicorder icon, turn on Pick Region and click the element you want. It highlights as you hover, like the element picker in DevTools, and a dotted border marks your choice.

record.title: Record
record.text: Press Record and use the page as usual. Only the picked element ends up in the video.

stop.title: Stop
stop.text: Press Stop. The MP4 lands in your Downloads folder.

exact.title: A focused recording, without post-record cropping
exact.text: The saved video is framed to the selected webpage element. You avoid enlarging a small crop from a full-window recording; the MP4 is encoded as it is saved.

smart.title: No dead time to trim
smart.text: With Smart recording on, sicorder stops adding frames after half a second without any visual change and picks up again when something moves.

pause.title: Pauses when you look away
pause.text: Scroll the element out of view or switch tabs and recording pauses, so the gap never shows up in the video.

autoStop.title: Stops on its own
autoStop.text: If the element disappears or the page navigates away, sicorder stops, saves what it recorded and tells you why.

names.title: Files you can find later
names.text: Recordings are named after the site, the element and the date, like github_pull_request_2026_09_14.mp4.

share.title: Ready to share
share.text: MP4 (H.264) plays in Slack, docs, pull requests, email and every video player.

audio.title: Add app audio or narration
audio.text: Record sound from the active tab, your microphone, or both. Audio is optional and only included when you turn it on.

still.title: Screenshots too
still.text: Switch to Still, click an element, and a pixel-exact PNG of just that element lands in Downloads, without the mouse pointer.

scroll.title: Scroll handled for you
scroll.text: Still captures bring the element into view first, then put the page back where it was.

developers.title: Web developers
developers.text: Show a bug, interaction, or finished feature in a pull request or issue, with only the relevant part of the page in frame.

designers.title: Designers and product managers
designers.text: Record a focused walkthrough of a component or interaction for a design review, product spec, or tutorial.

marketers.title: Marketers
marketers.text: Make product demos, tutorial clips, and launch videos that focus on the feature you want viewers to notice. Add app audio, voice-over, or both.

support.title: Support and documentation teams
support.text: Show one widget or one step without the rest of the interface.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Recording and encoding happen in your browser, and videos go straight to your Downloads folder. If you enable audio, Sicorder records sound from the active tab, your selected microphone, or both, and mixes it into the video locally. Your recordings are never uploaded, and page content, URLs, and file names are never sent. Sicorder sends anonymous usage statistics, such as how many recordings are started and saved. No account needed.

items.pages: Works on regular web pages (http and https). Chrome doesn't allow extensions to record its own pages, such as chrome:// settings or the Web Store.
items.audio: Audio is optional: record sound from the active tab, your microphone, or both.
items.pointer: The mouse pointer appears in the recording when it's over the picked element.
